blocks.text: Verity is as much the story of the film’s namesake as is the story of the characters that unfold that story. In the adaptation of Colleen Hoover’s sensual psychological thriller, celebrated author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) has requested to hire struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson) to help ghostwrite her upcoming novels. As Lowen stays in the Crawfords’ home, living with an unresponsive Verity, her husband Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and their son Crew (Brady Wagner), she uncovers disturbing secrets that change the reality she’s come to believe.
